outcome: Fear of childbirth (measured using the Wijma Delivery Expectancy/Experience Questionnaires (W-DEQ))
finding: The study found a relatively high prevalence of childbirth fear among pregnant women in Iran, with several factors such as parity, preferred mode of delivery, family income, and psychosocial factors influencing the level of fear.
mod_finding: Multiparas who preferred cesarean delivery had significantly higher childbirth fear scores compared to those who preferred vaginal delivery.
